camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2018-01-02T11:27:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2018-01-02T11:26:00Z'
description_en: Call the DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData operation to obtain the queries per second (QPS) data for an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData获取域名每秒访问次数的数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-real-time-qps-data --domain-name example.com --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en beijing --start-time 2018-01-02T11:26:00Z --end-time 2018-01-02T11:27:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeQpsData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify one or more domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the carrier.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query the English name of the carrier. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is returned
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query the English name of the region. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

Qps.description_en: The number of queries per second

TimeStamp.description_en: The data timestamp. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and is displayed in UTC
TimeStamp.description_zh: 数据时间戳，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间
